morgan: FYI ran a focused perf + accuracy sweep on Mistral-14B with AWQ/INT8 profiles, saw a surprising latency spike tied to RoPE scale changes. attaching quick dump below.

morgan: baseline (fp16)  p50: 68ms p95: 160ms tokens/sec: 1200
mistral-awq-int8   p50: 72ms p95: 380ms tokens/sec: 700  (tail increased)
intent: confirm whether kernel selector is switching to fallback kernels when RoPE scale deviates

morgan: short repro: 2-step sequence, warm KV cache, long prefix (1k tokens) then 512 gen. reproduced on local A100 and in staging dedicated pool.

morgan: profiling snapshot (nvprof-ish):
```
kernel: matmul_qk_awq  time 48ms  (hot)
kernel: qkv_gather_fallback  time 98ms (only on int8-awq + rope_scale=1.02)
KV cache warmup hit-rate: 0.94 -> 0.61 after scale bump
batcher: microbatch size 8 -> scheduler falls back to single microthread  (latency jitter)
```

devon: :eyes: can you paste the config you used for kernel-selector? especially the feature flags for rope-phase steering and head-kv thresholds

morgan: sure, minimal bits:
```json
{"kernel_selector": {"rope_phase_tolerance": 0.005, "prefer_awq_kernels": true, "kv_prefetch": "auto", "head_kv_threshold": 0.7}}
```

elena: Two quick hypotheses: 1) AWQ kernels assume per-head scaling invariants, small RoPE drift breaks SIMD path so we take scalar fallback. 2) Batcher's affinity metric uses observed kv-hit latency; when kv-hit drops it collapses microbatching -> higher p95.

ravi: I saw something similar on Mixtral experiments last month. We need a lightweight telemetry flag: emit kernel-switch reason in trace. infra-bot could do that on next deploy?

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: add-telemetry/kernel-switch-reason -> staging on 2026-04-02T09:00Z (rolling), will include a new trace tag kernel.reason and kernel.variant

samira: For accuracy: AWQ INT8 calibration prompts (we used a 256-token diverse set) lost ~1.4 BLEU-equivalent on prompt set vs GPTQ baseline. But zero-shot LM head metrics only small delta. So tradeoff is perf vs specific eval sets.

devon: Could the calibration prompt distribution be biasing RoPE scale? If the calibration data has mostly short sequences, RoPE scaling might not generalize to long-prefix workloads. We should rerun calibration with long-seq prompts.

morgan: I ran a micro-calib with long prompts (avg 800 tokens) and AWQ quantizer produced slightly different scales per-head. After re-calib: p95 dropped from 380ms -> 210ms and KV hit-rate recovered to 0.88. Accuracy stayed roughly the same.

elena: Nice. So path forward: (A) add trace flag for kernel switch reasons (B) expand calib corpus to include long prefixes for models we serve with long-context SLOs (C) add kernel selector hysteresis so tiny RoPE deviations don't flip to scalar fallbacks.

ravi: Also let's add a scheduler tweak: prefer to keep microbatch if tokens/sec above X even if one worker shows kv miss. That will smooth p95. We should simulate with our workload generator before shipping.

morgan: Agree. I've created a short checklist and next steps in the thread:
- [ ] infra: rollout telemetry tag (infra-bot scheduled)
- [ ] runtime: add kernel selector hysteresis (devon)
- [ ] runtime: batcher affinity tweak + simulation (ravi)
- [ ] qa: long-prefix calibration run and eval sweep (samira)

samira: I'll run a 3x calibration (short, mixed, long) and post accuracy/latency matrices. planning to include AWQ, GPTQ, and a gptq-int8 baseline.

devon: small implementation note: hysteresis should be time-based (~200ms) not just count, to avoid flip-flopping under noisy latency.

morgan: forwarding perf traces to the kernel team and tagging @elena and @devon in PR description.

elena: also check rope-phase normalization codepath for mixed-precision edgecases; i found one off-by-1 in head scaling on Mistral variants that could cause 1-2% per-head mismatch.

ravi: I'll add a unit test for head-scale invariants and a stress-case that ramps RoPE multiplier from 0.95 to 1.05 and asserts no kernel fallback for small deltas.

morgan: thanks all. If we get telemetry + hysteresis in staging and new calib results show p95 < 220ms we'll plan a canary next week. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: telemetry tag deployed to staging: kernel.reason present in traces for 24h sampling window.

samira: posted preliminary calibration matrix in the docs channel: short: +0.3 acc, mixed: -0.2, long: -0.1, but perf improvements as noted. Will attach CSV in this thread when complete.

devon: awesome. one more ask: include model variant details (heads, kv_dim) in the trace to cross-filter. makes bisecting faster.

morgan: added to action items. will update checklist and follow up with a canary plan.
